title: PotatoGuardNet: a refined deep learning framework for potato leaf disease detection.
summary: PotatoGuardNet uses an Inception-ResNet-V2 feature network with a two-stage Faster R-CNN detector to locate and classify potato leaf diseases. On complex PlantVillage potato images, the paper reports 99.41% classification accuracy and mean average precision of 0.9556; the authors also compare it with recent methods. This is a dataset evaluation, and the paper describes field deployment as potential rather than demonstrated.
ai_technology: PotatoGuardNet: Inception-ResNet-V2 based Faster R-CNN for potato leaf disease localization and classification.
organization: Department of Software Engineering, University of Engineering and Technology-Taxila

evidence.tested: Tested on potato-plant images from PlantVillage; reported 99.41% classification accuracy and mAP 0.9556. The paper also reports heatmap analysis and comparisons with recent methods.
evidence.unknown: The abstract does not establish performance in external farm conditions or deployment outcomes; the claimed practical deployment remains prospective.
evidence.ai_role: The deep detector identifies and classifies disease-specific visual patterns in potato leaf images.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
